Addon Summary: Song lyrics from your Jellyfin server
Addon Description: Shows lyrics from a Jellyfin server, either in a window drawn by this add-on or handed to a skin.
#30002: Show lyrics as each song starts, not only when the lyrics button is pressed. Some skins ignore this.
#30003: Show lyrics that have no timings
#30004: Untimed lyrics stay still instead of following the song. Some skins ignore this.
#30006: Raise it if lines come too early, lower it if they come too late.
#30010: From the top of the screen. 480 clears the now-playing info; 800 is full height.
